title: Canonical extensions of $p$-adic shtukas on toroidal compactifications of Shimura varieties
summary: We construct canonical extensions of $p$-adic shtukas on integral models of toroidal compactifications of abelian-type Shimura varieties with quasi-parahoric levels at any prime number $p$. More precisely, we define the notion of a log diamond as a $v$-sheaf associated with a log scheme over $\mathbb{Z}_p$ and construct a $p$-adic log shtuka over the log diamond of an integral toroidal compactification of an abelian-type Shimura variety by studying the ``degeneration'' of the shtuka at the boundary.
